what: قبل الرسم: انطباع واحد، الجمهور والسطح الأساسي، 2–3 منافسين ومنطقتهم، القيود — ثم قرار: نندمج في الفئة أم نكسرها. / Before drawing: one impression, audience + primary surface, 2–3 competitors, hard constraints; then fit-in vs break-out.
how: Brief block: Brand, ONE THING, For, Surface, Personality (3–5 adjectives), Must / Must-not feel, colour constraints; confirm before sketching. Mark type: wordmark for short phonetic names, lettermark for long names, combination mark as default for new products, pictorial/abstract only with recognition budget. Concept operators (one, max two): monogram + meaning, product action, metaphor fusion, negative space, construction geometry. Anti-slop constraints: positive ("identifiable in one flat colour", "reads at 16 px", mark works without wordmark), negative ("no gradient mesh", "no swoosh/globe", "avoid default SaaS blue"), reference-anchored ("like X’s restraint but warmer"); generate many, human curates — the curated vector is the deliverable. Three radical SVG directions, readable at 24 px, no gradients in the mono version.

what: أربعة أسئلة حاسمة كحد أقصى (المنتج والعرض، الجمهور، ما يجب أن يبقى، النبرة) ثم التزام: صفات ← خطوط ولون. / At most four forcing questions, then commit: adjectives → font pairs and a colour variant.
how: Map adjectives to fonts: technical → Geist / Space Grotesk; warm → Nunito Sans / Rubik / Manrope; authority → IBM Plex Sans / Public Sans; pair each with an Arabic face (IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Tajawal, Cairo, Readex Pro — ARAB-11). Sharp vs rounded shape language sets radii; light/dark from one sentence about where it is watched. HyperFrames design ask has three states: use the user’s frame.md/design.md, open 2–3 preset showcases so they pick by eye, or let the design step decide.

what: قواعد إنتاج صغيرة تجعل الفيديوهات المنفصلة تبدو علامة واحدة: أدوار الألوان، الخطوط وأحجامها لكل مقاس، التأطير، توقيتات الدخول والاستقرار والانتقال والإمساك، أدوار الصوت، الغلاف والختام، وفحوص التصدير. / A compact rule set so separate videos read as one brand.
how: Derive values from real tokens and record each source; keep one constants module (CSS :root or JS config) consumed by every composition; compare exports side by side for drift (colour, type, timing, loudness). KOSIF identity gate: claude-animation-studio new_scene.py writes a mandatory DESIGN.md (3–5 role colours, Arabic + Latin font, motion rules, do-not list; default bg #0F1A2B, ink #F4F7FF, accent #F6C76B, second #2B86E0). Brand kit pages: cover, square post, story, card + brand.md + tokens.json.

what: بدائية (color.blue.600) ← دلالية (color.text.default) ← مكوّن (button.bg.primary)؛ الثيمات تبدّل الطبقة الدلالية فقط، والعلامات × الأوضاع = ثيمات. / Primitive → semantic → component; themes swap semantic values only; brands × modes = themes.
how: Author W3C DTCG JSON ($value/$type); for video, a theme.json passed as Remotion props or read by GSAP scenes re-brands every scene ({brandA, brandB} × {light, dark} = 4 semantic maps). Typography tokens: --font-display, --font-text, --scale-ratio, --lh-display. Style Dictionary transforms to CSS vars (npm i -D style-dictionary).

what: نظام تصميم مكتوب للكاميرا: رموز الألوان وسلّم الخط بوحدات cqw وواجهة عرض وجلد ترجمة — 14 إعدادًا جاهزًا تختار منه بالعين. / A design system rewritten for the camera — tokens, cqw type ramp, showcase page and caption skin — 14 ready presets.
how: Open frame-presets/<name>/frame-showcase.html in Chromium, adopt FRAME.md as frame.md (resolution order frame.md → design.md → DESIGN.md). Presets: Biennale Yellow (paper #E9E5DB, sun #F1EE2E, ink #1B2566, ember #E26B4A; Instrument Serif + Archivo), BlockFrame (neo-brutalist 4 px black borders, #FFFDF5, pink #FE90E8, blue #C0F7FE), Blue Professional (#fdfae7, cobalt #1e2bfa; Space Grotesk + Inter), Bold Poster (Shrikhand + Libre Baskerville, red #D8000F), Broadside (fire-orange #E85D26 on cream #F0ECE5), Capsule (Bodoni Moda, coral #E85D4E, lime #C4D94E, grain), Cartesian (warm stone #EDE8E0, Playfair), Cobalt Grid (ink #1F2BE0 on #F0EBDE), Code Editorial (cream #FAF9F5, coral #CC785…), Coral (#E85D5D, Bebas Neue, 45° hatch), Creative Mode (cream #EFE9D9, four accents), Daisy Days (Fredoka, 3 px outlines, 6/4 px hard shadows), Editorial Forest (green #2e4a2a, pink #e89cb1). Swap the Latin display face for an Arabic partner. Remix tokens onto a preset with `node scripts/build-frame.mjs --preset <name> --hyperframes .` (tested upstream; needs npm install).

what: عشرة أجزاء: الاستراتيجية والنموذج الأصلي، مجموعة الشعار، الألوان بأزواج تباين، الخط وترخيصه، الشبكة، الأيقونات، الصور، الصوت، الممنوعات، والحوكمة بما فيها قواعد محتوى الذكاء. / Ten parts from strategy to governance incl. AI-content rules; plus a voice platform.
how: Build as a living HTML hub reading the token file, not a static PDF; colours in HEX/RGB/OKLCH with WCAG pairs. Voice: 3–5 attributes, tone-shift rules, do/don’t-say, glossary, messaging hierarchy; brand archetype aligns palette temperature, type, music and VO tone.

what: تراخيص الخطوط المكتبية نادرًا ما تغطي الفيديو أو التضمين؛ سجّل فئة الترخيص لكل خط وأحِل ادعاءات الملكية والتسجيل للمراجعة، واحفظ سجل التنقيح البشري لمفاهيم الذكاء. / Desktop/print font licences rarely cover video; record each font’s licence and route IP claims to review; log human curation of AI concepts.
how: Prefer OFL faces (Google Fonts, Noto, Cairo, Tajawal, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Amiri — proofs/_shared/fonts are OFL); list licences in the project credits; keep a curation-and-authorship log next to the project.

what: من مجلد موقع أو صفحة حية: العنوان والوصف والخطوط ولوحة متغيرات CSS والدعوات، تُطبَّع الألوان إلى hex ويُكتب خطة إطلاق. / From a site folder or live page: title, description, fonts, CSS-variable palette and CTAs; colours normalised to hex; a launch plan is written.
how: launch.to_hex: "#abc" → #aabbcc, "rgb(255 0 0 / 50%)" → #ff0000, "hsl(120,100%,50%)" → #00ff00, "oklch(100% 0 0)" → #ffffff, "oklch(0.5 0 0)" → #636363, invalid → None; launch.init(site, "polished", "vertical", 18, out) → material.json {palette, fonts, ctas, lang} + brag-plan.md (1080×1920, «ما هو، في جملة واحدة؟») — tested here (test_launch.Material). Live pages: Playwright getComputedStyle over all elements → radii (≥9999 = pill), shadows grouped by blur into elevation levels, transition durations micro/normal/macro, breakpoints 1440 → 768 → 390; full-height screenshots at 1920×1080 with ~30% overlap; summarise 5–7 colours, fonts, sections, CTAs and a vibe sentence. Use as mood input — never clone a brand you do not own.

name_en: Basma brand kit: import, palette-from-logo, watermark & end card
what: يقرأ مجلد العلامة أو zip أو دليل CSS/JSON/PDF، يستخرج الشعار والخطوط واللوحة والاسم والمعرّف، ويطبقها على كل فيلم: قفل اللوحة، خط الترجمة، علامة مائية، وبطاقة ختام متحركة. / Reads a brand folder/zip/guide, extracts logo, fonts, palette, name and handle, then applies them to every film.
how: BRAND.importFiles: JSZip 3.10.1, logo by name /logo|شعار|mark|icon|brand/ or first SVG; fonts by extension, weight guessed from the file name (black/heavy 900, extrabold 800, bold 700, semibold 600, medium 500, light/thin 300, variable "100 900"); BRAND.fromText finds #hex near primary/accent/background/text keywords (Arabic too) and 24 known fonts; PDFs via pdf.js (12 pages). colorsFromImage: 64×64 sample, skip alpha <128, near-black and near-grey, 4096 buckets weighted 1+2×saturation, distinct colours (L1 > 90), accent fallback = primary lightened 45%, bg #0d0d10 or primary×0.15. Watermark at (0.84, 0.07) width 16% on 9:16 or (0.9, 0.1) 12% otherwise, opacity 0.88; end card "brandend" 2.6 s when duration > 6 s (logo 34% pop, name, accent tagline, handle at 0.35/0.6/0.85 s). Free picture layers: pop/rise/fade/float, wheel resize ×1.06.

what: يجلب الشعار الرسمي (theSVG.org ثم صورة منظمة GitHub ثم أيقونة النطاق) ولا يرسم شعار علامة باليد أبدًا. / Fetches the official mark and never redraws a logo by hand.
how: `npx hyperframes media-use resolve --type logo --intent "stripe" --project .` (needs network providers). Use real marks only with permission and never as if the user owns them; in Fastify profiles only a user-owned wordmark may appear.

what: أصول مرسومة وSVG معقّم ورموز مربوطة كـ var() ومكونات وحركات تُترجم إلى GSAP — عبر حساب ومفاتيح. / Rendered assets, sanitised SVG, tokens as var(), components and motion translated to GSAP — with credentials.
how: figma/SKILL.md routing: five phases (assets, tokens, components, Motion via MCP → GSAP, shaders); a SECTION of frames reads as motion states; separate scoped credentials for REST and MCP. Canva MCP is catalogued only (proprietary).

name_en: SVG logo construction rules & logo suite
what: الشعار متجه خالص بمسارات (لا <text>)، viewBox فقط، ألوان hex صريحة، ومجموعات #mark و#wordmark لتحريك الأجزاء؛ ومجموعة كاملة: أفقي، مكدّس، رمز، كلمة، مساحة أمان، حد أدنى، أحادي، معكوس. / Pure vector paths, viewBox only, hard-coded hex, #mark/#wordmark groups; plus a full suite.
how: Outline fonts to paths for wordmarks (fonttools is a pip install; opentype.js an npm install); preserveAspectRatio xMidYMid; acid test: identifiable in flat black-and-white; 32 px legibility; clear space in mark units (e.g. cap height); do/don’t gallery (stretch, recolour, respace, drop shadow). Deterministic generator idea (brand-forge): wordmark, rounded-square monogram and 64×64 favicon SVG from palette + heading font — a short template here. Arabic wordmarks: shape with HarfBuzz/browser first, then outline (never per-letter paths from an unshaped font).

name_ar: تحويل الشعار النقطي إلى متجه بألوانه
what: يجد الألوان الصافية متجاهلًا حواف التنعيم، يكبّر بنعومة لتصير الحواف منحنيات، يتتبع كل لون ويوسع الطبقة قليلًا فلا تظهر فواصل. / Finds pure colours (skipping antialias blends), upscales smoothly, traces each colour and grows layers so no seams show.
how: vectorize.trace(path) → {layers[{color, name, area, centre, polys[{hole, pts}]}], silhouette}; CLI `python vectorize.py img` or `studio.py --trace img`; up 8× cubic, simplify 0.85 px, grow 2 px, ≤16 colours, merge distance 30. Verified here: aghnam_logo.png → 8 exact layers. vector_scene.build() turns the trace into a sign-painter reveal (radial backdrop #3d3648 → #121016, shadow offset 12 / alpha .45 / blur 18, largest layer first, each growing from its centroid; test_scenes_and_loading passed). If you only need a wrapper, embed the PNG in an SVG <image> (not real vectorisation); Potrace only for monochrome marks.

name_en: Icon families, app icons & favicon sets
what: عائلة أيقونات SVG حقيقية واحدة لكل عمل بشبكتها الأصلية وcurrentColor، ومن SVG مربع واحد: ICO 32، apple-touch 180، PWA 192/512، maskable 512 بمنطقة آمنة 409. / One real SVG icon family per piece; from one square SVG the full favicon/app-icon set.
how: 26-family catalogue (Lucide, Phosphor, Tabler, Radix 15×15, Carbon 16/20/24/32, Heroicons, Iconoir, Remix, Fluent…) — local SVG, no icon fonts, verify each licence. Owner recipes (tested: earth identity_unity 5/5, brand_art 5/5): app icon = radialGradient cx .28 cy .18 r 1.05 (#3a2f27 → #1d1814 → #110e0b), rx 112, inset white sheen .16 → 0 at mid-height, mark scale 1.4; `python3 tools/brand/make_marks.py` writes the SVGs and rasterises 192/512/180 with headless Chromium. Audit-studio sprite: 29 stroke symbols via <use href="#i-…">, stroke currentColor 1.8. Kawaii icon set (observed): thick 4 px outline, two dot eyes, small smile, one palette.

name_en: Owner marks built in code (SQC, K marks, ram, cloud)
what: مكتبة شعارات حقيقية مبنية كـ SVG: مونوغرام SQC بكريستال سداسي وعلامة تدقيق، حروف K بعدة لوكات، كبش تراثي، سحابة، وزخرفة فاصلة. / A library of real SVG marks: SQC monogram, K marks, heritage ram, cloud and ornament.
how: SQC (viewBox 300×110): S stroke 19, hex Q 150,16 183,35 183,73 150,92 117,73 117,35 with facets stroke 5 at .55, audit tick M164 80 l13 13 28-33 stroke 17, C arc, 12 px diamond at 45°; ledger gradient #f6c39b → #f2732d → #a53e07. K favicon 32 px: rect rx 8 #2F1B68, white K stroke 3, teal dot r3 #2EA6A6. Studio app icon 512: gradient #6366f1 → #8b5cf6 → #ec4899, emerald check badge r54. Ram emblem: horn strokes 50/34 px, browns #5b3519/#7a4a24/#9a6632 on #f4ead8. Cloud: viewBox 96×64, stroke 6.5, #f2a36b → #d9530e. Ornament 28×14 diamond + dots. Wordmarks: KOSIF EARTH in Montserrat 800 tracked .09em with amber #e8bd76.

name_en: AI mark generation (Recraft / prompt) then curate
what: Recraft يخرج SVG حقيقيًا ويقبل رفع أسلوب العلامة؛ أو أمر شعار مسطح بسيط — ثم تنقيح يدوي وتحريك المسارات بالكود. / Recraft outputs true SVG and accepts a brand style; or a flat minimal-mark prompt — then curate and animate the paths in code.
how: Upload 3–10 on-brand references as a style, generate SVG, overlay the exact brand hex afterwards, animate strokes/morphs. Prompt template: minimal modern logo mark for [brand], [symbol idea], flat vector, [2 HEX], balanced negative space, centred on white, no extra text — generators garble text, so wordmarks are set in real type. Painted covers: use a real frame as the reference (1600×900, <400 KB) and describe what is on screen, not the title.

what: بطاقات زجاجية بعمق تنفرج، خاتم ثماني ذهبي يُرسم، كلمة عربية ذهبية بأربع طبقات تنكشف من اليمين، لمعة معدنية بشريطين، وكلمة لاتينية يضيق تباعدها. / Glass cards part, a gold khatam draws on, a four-layer gold Arabic logotype reveals RTL, a two-streak shimmer crosses it, the Latin wordmark tightens.
how: Easing tokens luxe cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), glide (.65,0,.35,1), settle (.22,1.2,.36,1). Gold ramp #4a3110 #8a6424 #c9a24a #e8cf8a #fff4d6, champagne #f3e6c4; metal gradient 180° with stops at 0/16/40/56/68/86/100%. Logotype = glow (#c9a24a blur 26 px .42) + engraved edge (#4a3110 +4 px) + background-clip gold + shine copy through a 105° mask (main streak ±9%, follower .55). Timing: emblem draws 4.0–5.6 s, word reveals 4.9–6.25 s RTL with blur 10 → 0, shimmer 6.45–7.65 s then 8.85–9.75 s at 55%, tagline word by word from 7.0 s every 0.17 s. Glass: backdrop blur 22 px saturate 150%, radius 30 px. Rendered here 1920×1080 30 fps, 13/13 checks, −14.0 LUFS. Arabic never tracked — only the Latin NAFEES tightens 1.1em → 0.55em.

what: خط واحد يتتبع حدود الشعار ثم تتحول الحدود إلى تعبئة كاملة، مع وميض وشرارات اختيارية. / A line traces the outline, then the outline becomes a full fill.
how: Template (tested): `python3 scripts/mtemplates.py new NAME --template logo-reveal --set name=… --set tagline=… --set path="M…"` → pen draws the path (viewBox 120×136, default hexagon-in-hexagon) in 1.25 s, fill springs at 1.5 s with flash and sparkles, name + tagline reveal, slow push; 6 s, accent #E7B65A, bg #0f1a2b → #06101c. MG-021: draw 0–2 s, fill 2–2.6 s, hold to 4 s via stroke-dasharray/dashoffset + crossfade to the filled copy; simplify the reveal path for complex marks. Canvas starter closing card: spring 160/17 up 120 px, scale .94 → 1, monogram path dashoffset inOutCubic 0.4–1.2 s. Observed: chevrons draw ~1.5 s then fill 300 ms with glow; draw 700 ms + radial bloom fill; cyan ring 700 ms / 14 px / glow 30 px around a black disc.

what: ثلاث كتل تنزلق من اتجاهات مختلفة وتنغلق في الرمز، أو نقاط تترك شبكة وتسافر إلى حدود الشعار، أو بلاطات متساوية القياس، أو جسيمات تتجمع ثم يتلاشى الشعار الصلب. / Blocks slide in and lock, dots leave a grid for the contour, isometric tiles assemble, or particles gather before the solid logo crossfades.
how: MG-022: prep 0–0.6, assemble 0.6–1.8, hold to 3 s, respect proportions. MG-025: grid 0–1, travel 1–2.8, merge 2.8–4 s — sample targets with SVGPathElement.getPointAtLength. Dot-to-logo: drop 0–400 ms ease-in quad, squash 400–480, spring 10/220 to 800, morph 800–1500, wordmark 1500–1900 ease-out quint. Crowd-to-logo: drift 1.5 s, gather 1.2 s, crossfade 300 ms. Observed: 4 rounded tiles scale in 100 ms apart and one recolours; isometric extruded tiles (12 px) assemble in 600 ms back-out; pixel squares then mono typing. Morph: resample paths to 64–128 points, 500–800 ms.
params: MG-022 3 s · MG-025 4 s · morph 64–128 pts

name_ar: كشوف القناع: ظل، ضباب، ختم، فراغ سالب
name_en: Mask reveals: shadow pass, fog, ink stamp, negative space
what: ظل مائل يمسح الأرض فيبدو الشعار محفورًا، ضباب ينجرف جانبيًا، ختم يرتطم ويترك حوافًا غير منتظمة، أو أشكال تنغلق وتترك ثقبًا بشكل الشعار. / Slanted shadow pass, drifting fog, ink stamp with rough edges, or shapes closing to leave a logo-shaped hole.
how: MG-023 shadow: floor 0–1, pass 1–2.8, hold to 4 s (masks + inner shadow + fake gradient light — say it is a 2D simulation). MG-030 fog: 0–1 fog, 1–3 reveal, hold to 5 s; SVG feTurbulence mask; don’t let glow erase contrast. MG-024 stamp: drop 0–0.6, print 0.6–1, hold to 2.5 s with a grunge luma matte; keep a clean version for small sizes. Seal stamp after the last verse: red square #c0302a, scale 1.2 → 1 in 150 ms, multiply. MG-027 negative space: shapes approach 0–1.4, hole forms 1.4–2, hold to 3 s via SVG mask with the logo as hole; test light and dark versions.

name_ar: الرمز وحده ثم الكلمة تنكشف بجانبه
name_en: Mark alone, then wordmark unfolds beside it
what: الأيقونة في المنتصف وحدها (بتوهج)، ثم تنزاح جانبًا بينما تنكشف الكلمة بقناع، ثم الشعار النصي والرابط. / Icon centred alone with glow, then it slides aside as the wordmark reveals through a clip mask.
how: Shift 400 ms + mask 500–600 ms easeOutExpo; for Arabic the mark slides right and the word reveals right-to-left (mirror the Latin recipe). Variants: wordmark container max-width 0 → auto pushes the icon (spring damping ~12, unfold 0.5 s) with a giant faint backdrop word at 6–8%; asterisk mark spins in then slides (~1.5 s ease-out cubic); covers converge to centre and scale down behind the growing icon (800 ms, lockup gap 0.3em).

what: الكلمة اللاتينية تتكثف من تباعد واسع وضبابية إلى تباعد ضيق، ثم تهبط نقطة متنقلة كنقطة الجملة. / A Latin wordmark condenses from wide tracking and blur, then a travelling dot lands as its full stop.
how: fromTo letterSpacing 0.22em → −0.03em, opacity .4 → 1, blur 8 → 0 px in 0.8 s E.out; dot tween to its slot, scale .42; camera push 1 → 1.045 over 2.6 s; 132 px/700 wordmark, 44 px subline. Arabic companions must reveal by mask instead — never animate letter-spacing on Arabic (ARAB-03); in the luxury proof only NAFEES tracks while «نفيس» masks.

what: أربعة مربعات ملونة تدور عكس عقارب الساعة بسرعة تتناقص وتقفل على الجهات الأربع حول الأيقونة؛ أو 40 خطًا شعاعيًا / 12 شعاعًا تنطلق من المركز. / Four coloured squares spin CCW with decaying speed and lock at N/E/S/W; or radial lines/spokes burst from the centre.
how: Orbit r ≈ 216 px (≈1.2× icon), squares 92 px, lock in ~14 frames (~0.5 s), icon shrinks ease-out, then squares slide into a row; colours blue/cyan/mint/white. Spark burst: icon spins in, 40 radial lines shoot out and fade in 400 ms. Asterisk: 12 spokes (6 px, coral #f04a35) scale from 0 with 25–35 ms stagger backOut inside a thin circle. Ring pulse: icon spring 0 → 1 with an expanding ring fading. Orbit decoration: ellipse orbit + satellite dots; text on a circle path rotating around the logo.
params: orbit 216 px · lock ~0.5 s · 40 lines / 400 ms

what: بكرات عمودية بضبابية حركة تتباطأ وتقف على الشعار واحدة بعد أخرى؛ أو خط أفقي ساطع يتمدد بقوس توهج ثم ينزلق الشعار. / Motion-blurred reels decelerate onto the mark one after another; or a bright horizon line expands with a glow arc before the logo slides in.
how: Slot: 3 reels, stop stagger 250 ms, ease-out with a tiny overshoot. Horizon: line scaleX 0 → 1, glow arc above (GLOW), logo slides up from behind it.

name_en: HyperFrames logo blocks (sting, tiles, extruded, outro, intro, split-pulse)
what: شعار يرتطم بحلقة وإطار أبيض، كلمة تتكون من بلاطات ضجيج لونية، حروف ثلاثية الأبعاد بحواف تنقلب، شعار يتجمع بتوهج، وشعار ينقسم وينبض على الإيقاع. / Logo sting, wordmark tiles, extruded 3D letters, logo outro/intro, beat-synced split lockup.
how: `npx hyperframes add logo-sting | wordmark-tiles | extruded-logo | logo-outro | yt-logo-intro | logo-brand-close`; music template logo-split-lockup-pulse (2–4 s; >4.5 s reads stretched) grows a centre lockup per onset. wordmark-tiles columns 12 (8–14), wave stagger 40 ms; extruded-logo Three.js bevelled letters (chrome/gold/matte), 5 s; logo-outro 6 s with glow bloom + URL pill. Blueprint logo-assemble-lockup 4.4–11 s; category logo-reveal 3–5 s often as alpha overlay (FMT alpha). Latin defaults — feed Arabic as whole shaped words.
license: Apache-2.0 registry; GSAP inside uses its standard licence.

name_en: Remotion logo card: ring draw + chevron mark
what: بطاقة زجاجية تنبثق من 0.8، حلقة نصف قطرها 150 تُرسم، رمز جذع وشيفرون أصلي ينبثق، ثم العنوان وسطر «صُنع بـ KOSIF». / Glass card springs from .8, an r=150 ring draws, an original stem+chevron mark springs in, then title and credit fade up.
how: Card spring damping 14 stiffness 90 mass 1.1; ring progress(8, 40, inOutCubic); mark spring from frame 18 damping 11 stiffness 160; text progress(34, 18); card 760 px radius 48, paper@.06 bg, paper@.12 border, mark stroke 34.
license: Remotion company licence for teams above its free tier.

what: طبّق إزاحة «لطخة الأثر» على SDF الشعار أو نسيج نص عربي مشكّل لكشف سائل. / Apply a smear displacement to a logo SDF or a shaped Arabic text texture.
how: In the thermal-finger-trail shader replace the blob with texture2D(textTex, fuv); render the Arabic word to a CanvasTexture first (ARAB-10).

name_en: End-card anatomy (icon · wordmark · tagline · URL pill · CTA)
what: أيقونة، اسم، شعار نصي بكلمة مميزة، رابط في كبسولة، زر دعوة واحد، وتذييل صغير — تُبنى من الأعلى للأسفل بتتابع وتمسك 3–6 ث. / Icon, name, accent tagline, URL pill, one CTA and a small footer, built top-down and held 3–6 s.
how: Sizes (observed): icon 100 px, name 60 px, tagline 30 px, stagger 120–200 ms fade-up, hold 3–6 s, fade 500–600 ms; URL pill white/black with arrow and soft shadow 0 12 24 rgba(0,0,0,.15); row of outline chips or 3 value props separated by dots; blurred/darkened last scene behind; glowing app icon with purple radial glow (~40% width) on black; scrolling column of real preview tiles on the right (~60 px/s). Keep everything inside safe margins and one action only.

name_en: CTA end card with a cursor click
what: مؤشر ينزلق إلى زر الدعوة وينقر: الزر ينضغط إلى 0.96 وحلقة تموج تتسع. / A cursor glides to the CTA and clicks: the button depresses to 0.96 and a ripple ring expands.
how: Cursor path 500–600 ms easeOut, click scale 0.96 for 120 ms, ripple 0 → 60 px radius in 400 ms; CTA can pulse twice before the end freeze; never pretend a fake button is tappable in ads (FMT). Blueprint cta-morph-press: a resting mark condenses into a brighter CTA and a human-aimed click lands (4–6 s).

what: نقطة دائرية بلون العلامة تنهي الكلمة البطلة أو الشعار: تسقط وتنضغط وترتد، أو تنبثق بحلقة رفيعة، أو تحل محل نقطة حرف i. / A brand-colour round period ends hero words or the wordmark — dropping with squash, popping with a thin ring, or replacing the i-dot.
how: Dot = x-height × 0.45, scale 0 → 1.2 → 1 in 180–250 ms, 1–2 frames after the word lands; drop variant: stretched while falling 400 ms, squash 0.7 on impact, 2 bounces between two thin rules; red #e0262b with orbit ring; glow radius 300 px α .35 behind; kinetic cuts every 0.5 s always ending in a yellow square stop. For Arabic place the dot at the visual end on the left of the word and do not attach it inside the shaped run.

name_en: Release & developer end cards (version · terminal · Out now)
what: رقم إصدار ضخم بتدرج أو بخط سيريف مع «OUT NOW»، أو سطر طرفية «$ npm i …» يُكتب بمؤشر وامض. / Huge gradient or serif version number with OUT NOW, or a terminal install line typed with a blinking cursor.
how: Version gradient #1f7bf2 → #7b5cf5, fade/scale 500 ms; accent rule draws 400 ms under the number; "OUT NOW" tracked 0.2em (Latin); terminal box types at 40 ms/char, cursor blink 500 ms; minimal glyph + product name + small grey "Out now" typed, hold 2 s while music fades on a dB curve.
params: type 40 ms/char · blink 500 ms · rule 400 ms

name_en: Personal identity cards (name typed · contacts · chrome name)
what: شارة صورة واسم يُكتب بمؤشر، خط يُرسم، سطر الدور وكبسولات التواصل، وتوقيع بخط اليد؛ أو اسم عريض بتدرج معدني. / Avatar badge + typed name, rule draws, role line, contact pills and a script sign-off; or an extended chrome name card.
how: Type 40 ms/char (Arabic name: reveal per word, ARAB-29), pills stagger 60 ms; chrome card: extended uppercase name with vertical metallic gradient, role line between hairlines, italic serif tagline with one accent word fading per word 120 ms; handle lock-up: vertical accent bar left of the handle, letters rise 60 ms stagger, underline wipes 400 ms; pendulum dot swinging to rest (~1.5 s damping) while the name types.

name_en: Per-theme end-card library (17) + user-owned wordmark slot
what: ختام لكل ثيم (حروف تتجمع من دوامة فحم، حد سماوي يُرسم ثم يمتلئ، لمعة ذهبية واحدة، كلمة بيضاء على أحمر، كرة كروم تكشف الكلمة) — يضاف للمقطع الأخير فقط وفقط لعلامة يملكها المستخدم. / Per-theme outros added only to the last clip and only for a user-owned wordmark.
how: theme.endcard appended when i == n−1 and brand is set; the wordmark sits in a top-centre strip and the end card; every prompt states "no logos/watermarks" otherwise — no fake logos, no AI-added labels. Tested (production-profiles 10/10 here).

name_en: Closer blocks: CTA close/lockup, social proof, testimonials, trust strip
what: سطر فعل كبير بكبسولة دعوة واحدة ثم سكون، بطاقة متجر بخمس نجوم، اقتباس عميل بإيقاع القراءة، وصف علامات أحادي اللون. / Action line + one CTA capsule then stillness, app-store proof card, reading-paced testimonial, monochrome trust strip.
how: `npx hyperframes add cta-close | cta-lockup | social-proof-card | testimonial-card | testimonial-proof-card | trust-strip`; overrides via data-variable-values; extra duration becomes hold, never time-stretch. Use only real quotes, ratings and partner logos the user can show; observed alternatives: two rows of example cards drifting opposite (20 px/s, 10% edge fade) with a grey logo marquee; three marquee rows, centre bright, edges dim.
license: Apache-2.0 registry; GSAP inside uses its standard licence.

what: شعار ثابت في زاوية، علامة المنتج في الأخرى، رابط وتعليق في الأسفل عبر كل المشاهد؛ أو اسم الصانع بخط ذهبي رفيع يدخل في 0.4 ث. / Logo, product mark, URL and caption fixed in the corners across scenes; or a maker’s name with a gold hairline sliding in at 0.4 s.
how: Inset 4% each side; mono 11–12 px @1080p uppercase tracked 0.15em (Latin); only the centre content changes. verse.js V.brand: 26×k px weight 600, tracking .32em (Latin), #F7EBD0, line 70×k px rgba(231,182,90,.9), opacity .92. HUD brand bar (structural twin): 76 px frosted bar, 2 px border rgba(157,255,180,.28), radius 26, glowing 18 px lime dot, two-tone wordmark, pill flag. Arabic chrome: right-aligned, no tracking.

what: إطار العلامة غمر لوني كامل تفتحه قزحية من الشكل البطل، بكلمة لاتينية وسطر عربي يُكشف كلمة كلمة؛ أو لون العلامة يكبر من خط 4 بكسل إلى ملء كامل. / A full-screen colour flood opened by an iris from the hero shape, Latin wordmark + Arabic line revealed per word; or a 4 px line growing to full fill.
how: five_sec: radial gold gradient; "KOSIF Motion" Space Grotesk 150 px/700; «نسخة ٥٫٢» Cairo 78 px/800; revealWords at 4.15 s (0.6 s, stagger .06) and 4.35 s. Progression brief: 4 px line → pills → 100% in the last 2 s.

what: title-card، lower-third، stat-counter، quote-card، logo-reveal، countdown، end-card، bullet-list — عربية أولًا وCairo مضمّن. / Eight Arabic-first templates with Cairo embedded.
how: `python3 scripts/kmotion.py template list`; `template new NAME --template logo-reveal --set title=… --set accent=#E7B65A`; every template generates and lints (tested here). Pass the brand tokens as --set values so all eight share one palette (ARAB-49).

what: شبكة متحركة تخلط لحظات واجهة حقيقية مع الرمز واللوحة والخط، بتتابع يجعل خلية واحدة تهيمن في كل لحظة. / A moving grid mixing real UI moments with mark, palette and type, staggered so one cell dominates at a time.
how: 2×2 for 16:9/1:1, vertical stack for 9:16; each cell its own clock; avoid simultaneous flashes; check first/last frame of each clip for blanks. Case-study variant: each case gets its own full-frame palette. Designed sleeves: flat colour squares with bold 2-line uppercase title and a motif (rings or bars).

what: صفوف = بارامترات (الجسم، الشق، العمق، العرض، الزاوية، الدوران، التعبئة، الإزاحة) وأعمدة = قيم؛ تُضاء خلية مختارة في كل صف وتتصل بخط ثم يتجمع الرمز النهائي. / Rows = parameters, columns = values; one cell lit per row, connected by a polyline, then the final mark assembles.
how: 8 params × 6 values = 1,679,616 combinations (caption the total), row stagger 120 ms; build in SVG with the generator function so the shown cells really produce the mark.

name_en: Card & badge systems (neo-brutalist, seal, pill, banner)
what: بطاقات بحد أسود 3 بكسل وظل صلب، ختم دائري مسنن، كبسولة بنقطة حية نابضة، شريط تاريخ بخطوط ملونة، وشريط أحمر مائل للعنوان. / Neo-brutalist cards, scalloped seal badge, pill with a live dot, striped date banner, diagonal red title band.
how: Neo-brutalist: 3 px black border, hard shadow 6px 6px 0 #111, pastel fills pink #f47fe0, cyan #c8f8f8, green #9bf08a, yellow #f0cf4a, radius 0–6 px. Seal: ~24-point star rim, inner circle with number + label, rotate −30° → 0, wobble ±3°. Pill: rounded-full outline, 11–13 px 700 tracked (Latin), 1 px border, pulsing red dot. Date banner: 4 bars ~6 px each scaleX 0 → 1 in 300 ms then label, width 88%. Title band: crimson #cd002f rotated −12°, slams in 150 ms. Logo card spring k=200 d=14, later shrinks to 0.6 in 500 ms for re-layout.

name_en: Wordmark treatments (glow, gradient, per-letter colour, footer, hyphen)
what: كلمة بيضاء بتوهج، كلمة بتدرج، حروف بألوان مختلفة مع أشكال تتمايل، كلمة ضخمة تنزف من أسفل الإطار، وواصلات بلون مميز. / Glowing white wordmark, gradient wordmark, per-letter colours with bobbing shapes, giant footer wordmark, accent hyphens.
how: Glow: hard cut to black, text-shadow 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,.5) + subtle radial lift, hold ~2 s. Gradient: teal → yellow over residual particles. Per-letter colour (Latin): 60 ms stagger, primitives bob 6 px / 2 s — for Arabic colour per word, never per letter. Giant footer word bleeding off the bottom, sliding up. Serif + heavy tracked sans pairing (tracking 0.3em on Latin labels only). Spaced-caps title on black, 0.5em tracking, per-letter fade 60 ms, hold 6–8 s (Latin only).

what: إعلان متجهي على خلفية استوديو داكنة: عنوان عربي ذهبي متدرج، كبسولة الوزن، شعار شارة، أدوات، منتج بإضاءة حافة، صندوق بشريط أحمر وأرقام هاتف. / A vector product ad: gold-gradient Arabic headline, weight pill, badge logo, tools, rim-lit product, branded box with phone numbers.
how: `python studio.py ad_whole_sheep`; badge #a8c13a/#ffffff/#e3161d, headline #f6e3b6 → #c49c5c, pill #ead6b0 → #cfb085, table #2a1010, band #c91a1f; helpers rrect(), badge(), meat(), lines(); coordinates remapped by P()/M(). Text shaped by Pillow RAQM here.

name_en: Ledger-paper design system & manifest title look
what: ورق كريمي، حدود حبر رفيعة، ظلال هامسة، أزرار كبسولة محددة، ولون زعفراني واحد — بوضعين فاتح وداكن. / Cream canvas, thin ink borders, whisper shadows, outline pill buttons, one saffron accent — light and dark tokens.
how: paper #fbf8f3/#161310, paper-2 #f3ece2/#1f1b17, card #fffdf9/#1c1814, ink #1d1814/#f5ede3, ink-2 #4b4139, ink-3 #7b6f64, rule #e0d5c8, accent #d9530e/#f2732d, good #2c7a4b. Manifest title-card canvas (pure in t): bg #11171b, accent radial glow at (.28w, .25h) r .8w, faint grid every unit/12, three slowly rotating accent ellipses, rising Arabic title, mono "KOSIF / MOTION" mark, scene counter.
